say:0:1013801001:0.text: Magister, there's no sign of the Adamant Syndicate here...
say:0:1013801001:0.source_cn: 主人，这里好像没有黑金商会的踪迹……
say:0:1013801001:0.male: Magister, there's no sign of the Adamant Syndicate here...
say:0:1013801001:0.female: Magister, there's no sign of the Adamant Syndicate here...

say:1:1013801002:0.text: That's odd. Weren't they supposed to be here?

say:2:1013801003:0.text: Shakir's intel pointed to their activity at the Sun Temple...
say:2:1013801003:0.source_cn: 根据沙奎尔的情报，他们会在日神殿有所行动……

say:0:1013804001:0.text: Ahh, I don't want to die! Magister hasn't patted my head yet today, I can't dieeee!
say:0:1013804001:0.source_cn: 呜哇啊啊啊！我不想死！主人今天还没摸我的头，我不能死啊啊啊！
say:0:1013804001:0.male: Ahh, I don't want to die! Magister hasn't patted my head yet today, I can't dieeee!
say:0:1013804001:0.female: Ahh, I don't want to die! Magister hasn't patted my head yet today, I can't dieeee!

say:1:1013804002:0.text: Don't worry! As long as I, Lucius, am here, no harm will befall anyone!
say:1:1013804002:0.source_cn: 艾雅在上，现在说死还太早了！只要我卢修斯活着，就绝不会...

say:2:1013804003:0.text: The tremors seem to be coming from under the platform, let's investigate.
say:2:1013804003:0.source_cn: 震动的源头……好像是平台下方。我们去地下探查一下情况吧。

say:1:1013811001:0.source_cn: 特弥希娅……不应该……是这样的……

say:2:1013811002:0.text: Why... do you still have to suffer? Why... why?!
say:2:1013811002:0.source_cn: 为什么……你还要付出代价？为什么……为什么？！

say:3:1013811003:0.text: She could've chosen not to be a Templar Knight! She wouldn't have ever been in danger...
say:3:1013811003:0.source_cn: 特弥希娅本可以不做圣骑士的！那样，她不会遇到魔物，也不...

say:4:1013811004:0.text: But she chose to be a knight... she's so selfless, she gave her all to protect more people.
say:4:1013811004:0.source_cn: 但她最终还是选择成为骑士。因为那颗心并不只属于她的朋友...

say:6:1013811005:3.text: Your goddess—Dura, if she exists, why would she treat her most devoted follower this way?
say:6:1013811005:3.source_cn: 你们的神——艾雅，如果存在，为什么要这样对待她最虔诚的信徒？

say:7:1013811006:1.text: Dura above... I beg for your forgiveness for humanity's transgressions and plead for your mercy. I implore you...
say:7:1013811006:1.source_cn: 女神在上……祈求您饶恕世人的过犯，并降下恩典。祈求您……

choice_prompt:8:1013811006.text: Dura above... I beg for your forgiveness for humanity's transgressions and plead for your mercy. I implore you...
choice_prompt:8:1013811006.source_cn: 女神在上……祈求您饶恕世人的过犯，并降下恩典。祈求您……

narration:11:1013811008:0.text:
The noise around you feels like it's coming from far away.
Suddenly, a strange woman's voice echoes in your ears.
...A deep sense of familiarity rushes over you.
You feel like you know the owner of this voice.
narration:11:1013811008:0.source_cn: 周遭的嘈杂仿佛从遥远的地方传来。\n突兀地，耳边响起奇...

say:12:1013811009:2.text: Temesia... hold steadfast in guarding your heart.
say:12:1013811009:2.source_cn: 特弥希娅……这个世界上，坚定你的守护之心吧。

say:13:1013811010:0.text: For yourself, for everything, and for me too...
say:13:1013811010:0.source_cn: 为了你，为了那一切，也为了我……

say:15:1013811012:0.text: Merlin, you'll face a trial too. It's not me testing you, but destiny.
say:15:1013811012:0.source_cn: 梅林，你也将面临试炼。试炼你的并不是我，而是命运。
say:15:1013811012:0.male: Merlin, you'll face a trial too. It's not me testing you, but destiny.
say:15:1013811012:0.female: Merlin, you'll face a trial too. It's not me testing you, but destiny.

say:16:1013811013:1.text: I know you'll make the right choice. I believe in you... and your heart.
say:16:1013811013:1.source_cn: 我知道，你会作出正确的选择。我相信……你的心。
say:16:1013811013:1.male: I know you'll make the right choice. I believe in you... and your heart.
say:16:1013811013:1.female: I know you'll make the right choice. I believe in you... and your heart.

say:0:1013812001:0.text: What was that voice just now...?
say:0:1013812001:0.source_cn: 刚才的声音是怎么回事……
say:0:1013812001:0.male: What was that voice just now...?
say:0:1013812001:0.female: What was that voice just now...?

say:1:1013813001:3.source_cn: 特弥希娅！太好了、太好了……

say:2:1013813002:1.text: Ahem... I mean, whew, you're okay. Stop making <style="stress"><player_name></style> worry so much!
say:2:1013813002:1.source_cn: 咳……我是说，既然没事，就别让<style=stres...
say:2:1013813002:1.male: Ahem... I mean, whew, you're okay. Stop making <style="stress"><player_name></style> worry so much!
say:2:1013813002:1.female: Ahem... I mean, whew, you're okay. Stop making <style="stress"><player_name></style> worry so much!

say:3:1013813003:1.text: How are you feeling now? Just so you know, if you hadn't woken up, I was going to steal that Faith Stone—
say:3:1013813003:1.source_cn: 现在感觉怎么样？事先说明，你要是再不醒，我就去偷了上面...

say:4:1013813004:1.text: Atalanta, saying things like that in front of a Templar Knight... Should I pretend I didn't hear that?
say:4:1013813004:1.source_cn: 阿塔兰忒，在圣骑士面前说这种话……我该装作没听到吗？

choice_prompt:5:1013813004.text: Atalanta, saying things like that in front of a Templar Knight... Should I pretend I didn't hear that?
choice_prompt:5:1013813004.source_cn: 阿塔兰忒，在圣骑士面前说这种话……我该装作没听到吗？

say:6:1013813005:2.text: Why does it feel like Temesia's become much livelier even though she just went through a life-threatening experience...?
say:6:1013813005:2.source_cn: 怎么觉得特弥希娅从生死关头走了一遭……变得活泼了许多？

say:8:1013813006:3.text: Sorry. I tried to lighten the mood, but I guess cracking jokes still isn't my forte.
say:8:1013813006:3.source_cn: 抱歉。本想宽慰大家的，现在看来，我果然还是把握不好说俏...

say:10:1013813007:1.text: I'm okay now. No need to worry about me.
say:10:1013813007:1.source_cn: 我已经没事了。不必为我担心，阿塔，还有诸位。

say:11:1013813008:1.text: Illucia didn't do anything else after I collapsed, did she?
say:11:1013813008:1.source_cn: 我倒下后，伊露西卡没有采取别的行动吧？

say:13:1013813010:1.text: This is bad. <style="stress"><player_name></style> mentioned she might be up to something related to the Hypogean Rift...
say:13:1013813010:1.male: This is bad. <style="stress"><player_name></style> mentioned she might be up to something related to the Hypogean Rift...
say:13:1013813010:1.female: This is bad. <style="stress"><player_name></style> mentioned she might be up to something related to the Hypogean Rift...

choice_prompt:14:1013813010.text: This is bad. <style="stress"><player_name></style> mentioned she might be up to something related to the Hypogean Rift...
choice_prompt:14:1013813010.source_cn: 不好，<style=stress><player_name></style>说过，她可能要对恶魔裂隙做些什么……
choice_prompt:14:1013813010.male: This is bad. <style="stress"><player_name></style> mentioned she might be up to something related to the Hypogean Rift...
choice_prompt:14:1013813010.female: This is bad. <style="stress"><player_name></style> mentioned she might be up to something related to the Hypogean Rift...

say:15:1013813011:3.text: We have to stop her as soon as possible!

choice:14:0:1.text: Shouldn't we take a second to rest?
choice:14:0:1.male: Shouldn't we take a second to rest?
choice:14:0:1.female: Shouldn't we take a second to rest?

say:0:1013814001:0.text: Darn it... get away from the Faith Stone!
say:0:1013814001:0.source_cn: 可恶的……家伙……离圣石远一点！

say:1:1013814002:0.text: Templar Knight!... P-protect the Faith Stone!

say:1:1013818001:0.source_cn: 发生了什么？那个裂隙……把伊露西卡吞进去了？

say:3:1013818002:0.text: This taboo magic... it's so horrifying. She probably didn't expect this outcome...
say:3:1013818002:0.source_cn: 所谓献祭自身的禁忌魔法，竟是这般非人的景象。她自己也未...

choice_prompt:4:1013818002.text: This taboo magic... it's so horrifying. She probably didn't expect this outcome...
choice_prompt:4:1013818002.source_cn: 所谓献祭自身的禁忌魔法，竟是这般非人的景象。她自己也未必预料得到这个结果吧……

say:5:1013818003:2.text: She thought she was in charge, but she turned out just to be a pawn... What a tragic story.
say:5:1013818003:2.source_cn: 自以为是导演，最后却发现自己不过是个大型道具……这种戏...

say:1:1013820001:1.text: Hello hello! Welcome, ladies and gentlemen!
say:1:1013820001:1.source_cn: 早上中午晚上好，女士们先生们！

say:2:1013820002:1.text: I'm the clown Berial, here to entertain! Anything interesting happened in the last few millennia? I've been trapped for far too long...
say:2:1013820002:1.source_cn: 小丑贝利尔在此。最近几千年发生了什么有趣的事吗？我可被...

say:4:1013820003:1.text: Magister! He must be a Hypogean, since he came from the Hypogean Rift.
say:4:1013820003:1.source_cn: 主人，他是从恶魔裂隙里冒出来的，所以他是……恶魔？
say:4:1013820003:1.male: Magister! He must be a Hypogean, since he came from the Hypogean Rift.
say:4:1013820003:1.female: Magister! He must be a Hypogean, since he came from the Hypogean Rift.

say:5:1013820004:1.text: I told you, I'm a clown. Stop getting hung up on labels. Why can't you just enjoy my show? Your expression changes when you talk about Hypogeans...
say:5:1013820004:1.source_cn: 都说了，我是小丑。何必拘泥于字眼呢？你们可以尽情享受小...

say:6:1013820005:1.text: That makes me sad! Have you heard the joke about the sad clown going to the doctor and the doctor prescribing him medication? The prescription was—
say:6:1013820005:1.source_cn: 我真伤心。听过那个笑话吗？小丑忧郁地去看医生，医生给他...

say:7:1013820006:1.text: The liver of a chubby hamster, taken while it's alive. Ah... I bet it would be quite delicious!
say:7:1013820006:1.source_cn: 一只肥仓鼠的肝脏，活取服用。啊……我敢保证一定很鲜美。

say:10:1013820008:1.text: Then are you planning on cooking your hamster, plating it, and serving it to me?
say:10:1013820008:1.source_cn: 莫非您打算把您的仓鼠煮熟，端在盘子里送给我？
say:10:1013820008:1.male: Then are you planning on cooking your hamster, plating it, and serving it to me?
say:10:1013820008:1.female: Then are you planning on cooking your hamster, plating it, and serving it to me?

say:11:1013820009:1.text: No? Then, I'd rather not eat it.
say:11:1013820009:1.male: No? Then, I'd rather not eat it.
say:11:1013820009:1.female: No? Then, I'd rather not eat it.

say:12:1013820010:1.text: You sure know how to spoil the mood. I admit, you've piqued my interest.
say:12:1013820010:1.source_cn: 您真懂得如何扫兴。我承认，这反倒引起我的兴趣。
say:12:1013820010:1.male: You sure know how to spoil the mood. I admit, you've piqued my interest.
say:12:1013820010:1.female: You sure know how to spoil the mood. I admit, you've piqued my interest.

say:13:1013820014:1.text: Magister Merlin, I'm beginning to take quite a liking to you. I might even perform exclusively for you if you can afford it.
say:13:1013820014:1.source_cn: 梅林，我真中意您。我甚至想只为您一人表演，前提是您出得...
say:13:1013820014:1.male: Magister Merlin, I'm beginning to take quite a liking to you. I might even perform exclusively for you if you can afford it.
say:13:1013820014:1.female: Magister Merlin, I'm beginning to take quite a liking to you. I might even perform exclusively for you if you can afford it.

say:14:1013820015:2.text: How did you know his identity?!
say:14:1013820015:2.source_cn: 你怎么知道主人的身份？！
say:14:1013820015:2.male: How did you know his identity?!
say:14:1013820015:2.female: How did you know her identity?!

say:15:1013820016:1.text: *Giggle* Oh, was it a secret? Well anyways, it looks like there's nothing exciting happening here. If there's no fun, this clown is gonna take off—
say:15:1013820016:1.source_cn: 秘密！看来这里没什么好玩的事了。如无安可，小丑退场——

say:17:1013820017:2.text: Stop! We Templar Knights vowed to guard Dura and her people. No Hypogeans shall escape us and wreak havoc on the world!
say:17:1013820017:2.source_cn: 止步，我等守护艾雅与艾雅子民的圣骑士，决不能允许恶魔出...

say:18:1013820018:2.text: It feels like nothing has changed, even after all this time. The world is still full of boring people...
say:18:1013820018:2.source_cn: 看来这么久过去，什么都没改变。世上还是无趣的人多啊……

say:20:1013820011:1.text: I know, I know, you're their owner. Are you thinking of keeping them as emergency rations?
say:20:1013820011:1.source_cn: 我知道，您是仓鼠的饲主。这两只仓鼠，您是打算留着当储备粮吗？
say:20:1013820011:1.male: I know, I know, you're their owner. Are you thinking of keeping them as emergency rations?
say:20:1013820011:1.female: I know, I know, you're their owner. Are you thinking of keeping them as emergency rations?

choice_prompt:21:1013820011.text: I know, I know, you're their owner. Are you thinking of keeping them as emergency rations?
choice_prompt:21:1013820011.source_cn: 我知道，您是仓鼠的饲主。这两只仓鼠，您是打算留着当储备粮吗？
choice_prompt:21:1013820011.male: I know, I know, you're their owner. Are you thinking of keeping them as emergency rations?
choice_prompt:21:1013820011.female: I know, I know, you're their owner. Are you thinking of keeping them as emergency rations?

say:23:1013820012:2.text: I knew the magister loved us!
say:23:1013820012:2.source_cn: 我就知道主人是真心爱我们的！
say:23:1013820012:2.male: I knew the magister loved us!
say:23:1013820012:2.female: I knew the magister loved us!

say:24:1013820013:2.text: Hey, Chippy's super strong! Uh, wait a minute...
say:24:1013820013:2.source_cn: 不对，满满我可是很壮实的哦！……呃，等一下等一下……
say:24:1013820013:2.male: Hey, Chippy's super strong! Uh, wait a minute...
say:24:1013820013:2.female: Hey, Chippy's super strong! Uh, wait a minute...

say:2:1013824001:2.text: Berial's appearance actually caught the attention of two Celestials...
say:2:1013824001:2.source_cn: 贝利尔竟然引来了两位半神阁下现身……

say:3:1013824002:2.text: It's nice to see you all again, but now is not the time to linger. You should know that Berial is a Hypogean.
say:3:1013824002:2.source_cn: 诸位，又见面了。现在可不是悠哉的时候。你们应该知道，贝...

say:4:1013824003:1.text: I can't say I'm close to Scarlita, but one thing's certain—she won't let Berial off easy.
say:4:1013824003:1.source_cn: 我不敢说跟斯克嘉莉德关系很好，但有件事是肯定的——她不...

say:5:1013824004:0.text: Thankfully, the rift was only open for a brief time. There shouldn't be another Hypogean appearing.
say:5:1013824004:0.source_cn: 不幸中的万幸是，裂隙只张开了一瞬间。短时间内，应该不会...

say:6:1013824005:2.text: But there might be some Hypofiends sneaking out. Be prepared... especially you, Magister Merlin.
say:6:1013824005:2.source_cn: 但多半会有些不好对付的魔物从里面钻出来。你们要准备好应...
say:6:1013824005:2.male: But there might be some Hypofiends sneaking out. Be prepared... especially you, Magister Merlin.
say:6:1013824005:2.female: But there might be some Hypofiends sneaking out. Be prepared... especially you, Magister Merlin.

choice_prompt:7:1013824005.text: But there might be some Hypofiends sneaking out. Be prepared... especially you, Magister Merlin.
choice_prompt:7:1013824005.source_cn: 但多半会有些不好对付的魔物从里面钻出来。你们要准备好应对……尤其是你，梅林。
choice_prompt:7:1013824005.male: But there might be some Hypofiends sneaking out. Be prepared... especially you, Magister Merlin.
choice_prompt:7:1013824005.female: But there might be some Hypofiends sneaking out. Be prepared... especially you, Magister Merlin.

say:8:1013824006:1.text: Do you really? Right now... the world needs your strength.
say:8:1013824006:1.source_cn: 你明白吗？现在……世界需要你的力量。
say:8:1013824006:1.male: Do you really? Right now... the world needs your strength.
say:8:1013824006:1.female: Do you really? Right now... the world needs your strength.

say:9:1013824008:1.text: If the Hypogeans come forth, the same tragedies of the past might repeat. It's time to manipulate the strands of fate and prevent a sorrowful tune.
say:9:1013824008:1.source_cn: 恶魔现世，生灵涂炭的悲剧可能重演。现在开始拨动命运的丝...
say:9:1013824008:1.male: If the Hypogeans come forth, the same tragedies of the past might repeat. It's time to manipulate the strands of fate and prevent a sorrowful tune.
say:9:1013824008:1.female: If the Hypogeans come forth, the same tragedies of the past might repeat. It's time to manipulate the strands of fate and prevent a sorrowful tune.

say:10:1013824009:1.text: This must also be what Dura hopes to see.
say:10:1013824009:1.source_cn: 这——应当也是艾雅希望看到的吧。
say:10:1013824009:1.male: This must also be what Dura hopes to see.
say:10:1013824009:1.female: This must also be what Dura hopes to see.

choice_prompt:11:1013824009.text: This must also be what Dura hopes to see.
choice_prompt:11:1013824009.source_cn: 这——应当也是艾雅希望看到的吧。
choice_prompt:11:1013824009.male: This must also be what Dura hopes to see.
choice_prompt:11:1013824009.female: This must also be what Dura hopes to see.

say:12:1013824010:1.text: I believe in you. It's not just me; it's also Dura's will...
say:12:1013824010:1.source_cn: 我相信你，这不只是我，也是艾雅的意志……
say:12:1013824010:1.male: I believe in you. It's not just me; it's also Dura's will...
say:12:1013824010:1.female: I believe in you. It's not just me; it's also Dura's will...

say:13:1013824011:1.text: What's concerning isn't just this place, but if the other Hypogeans in the rift are getting restless.
say:13:1013824011:1.source_cn: 令人忧心的不止是这一处，深渊中的其他恶魔是否也都蠢蠢欲...
say:13:1013824011:1.male: What's concerning isn't just this place, but if the other Hypogeans in the rift are getting restless.
say:13:1013824011:1.female: What's concerning isn't just this place, but if the other Hypogeans in the rift are getting restless.

say:14:1013824012:1.text: Good wine, beautiful people, all the laughter and joys of the world... I'm afraid the good days might be over from now on. Farewell, Magister.
say:14:1013824012:1.source_cn: 醇酒、美人、世间种种欢笑享乐……恐怕从现在开始，我的好...
say:14:1013824012:1.male: Good wine, beautiful people, all the laughter and joys of the world... I'm afraid the good days might be over from now on. Farewell, Magister.
say:14:1013824012:1.female: Good wine, beautiful people, all the laughter and joys of the world... I'm afraid the good days might be over from now on. Farewell, Magister.

say:16:1013824007:1.text: Caution has been Dura's gift to you. But now, we need your strength.
say:16:1013824007:1.source_cn: 当然，谨慎之心是艾雅对你的恩赐。但现在，我们需要你的力量。
say:16:1013824007:1.male: Caution has been Dura's gift to you. But now, we need your strength.
say:16:1013824007:1.female: Caution has been Dura's gift to you. But now, we need your strength.

say:0:1013825001:0.text: Things have reached an end... I didn't expect it to finish like this...
say:0:1013825001:0.source_cn: 事情算是告一段落了……没想到竟然是这样的结局……
say:0:1013825001:0.male: Things have reached an end... I didn't expect it to finish like this...
say:0:1013825001:0.female: Things have reached an end... I didn't expect it to finish like this...

say:1:1013825002:0.text: It may still be dangerous here, please retreat to the square for now.
say:1:1013825002:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，恶魔裂隙可能还有隐患，请先行撤退到广场那里吧。
say:1:1013825002:0.male: It may still be dangerous here, please retreat to the square for now.
say:1:1013825002:0.female: It may still be dangerous here, please retreat to the square for now.

say:2:1013825003:0.text: We can also discuss future plans there, considering the Hypogeans have reappeared...
say:2:1013825003:0.source_cn: 也好，在那里也问问大家的打算吧，毕竟恶魔再度现身了……
say:2:1013825003:0.male: We can also discuss future plans there, considering the Hypogeans have reappeared...
say:2:1013825003:0.female: We can also discuss future plans there, considering the Hypogeans have reappeared...

say:1:1013826001:3.text: Thanks to Dura's mercy, we have been saved...
say:1:1013826001:3.source_cn: 感谢艾雅的悲悯，将拯救的力量送到我们身边……

say:2:1013826002:1.text: Dura above, I'm glad no one was seriously hurt.
say:2:1013826002:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，你们没有受重伤就好。

say:3:1013826003:2.text: But... we've failed Dura by not protecting the Faith Stone!
say:3:1013826003:2.source_cn: 但是……我们辜负了艾雅的恩泽，没能守护好圣石！

say:4:1013826004:1.text: The only Faith Stone in the world has been shattered... what do we do now?
say:4:1013826004:1.source_cn: 世界上仅有一块的圣石破碎了……这该怎么办才好？

say:8:1013826006:1.text: Thank you again for your assistance. Templar Knight Temesia, we should discuss our next steps.
say:8:1013826006:1.source_cn: 再次感谢诸位的相助。圣骑士特弥希娅，我需要和您谈谈接下...

say:9:1013826007:1.text: Ah, of course. Lucius, you should come too.
say:9:1013826007:1.source_cn: 啊，这是当然的。卢修斯，你也一起来吧。

say:10:1013826008:1.text: I believe it would be prudent for you to return to the Temple quickly.
say:10:1013826008:1.source_cn: 关于目前的情况……有必要快些向圣堂报告——

say:11:1013826009:1.text: Of course, we must report what happened here as soon as possible!
say:11:1013826009:1.source_cn: 没错，必须尽快向上汇报这里的事！

say:12:1013826010:1.text: Some people should stay here and keep an eye on the rift in case anything happens.
say:12:1013826010:1.source_cn: 你也要留下一部分人看守裂隙，免得事情生变。

say:13:1013826011:1.text: Lucius, you should return to Holistone and report to the general soon.
say:13:1013826011:1.source_cn: 卢修斯，稍后你先行返回圣石镇汇报此事。

say:3:1013827002:1.text: Hmm. If it weren't for you handling things, that stubborn girl and I might never have resolved our issues.
say:3:1013827002:1.source_cn: 哼。要不是你把事情解决了，我和那个一根筋的家伙……未必...
say:3:1013827002:1.male: Hmm. If it weren't for you handling things, that stubborn girl and I might never have resolved our issues.
say:3:1013827002:1.female: Hmm. If it weren't for you handling things, that stubborn girl and I might never have resolved our issues.

choice_prompt:4:1013827002.text: Hmm. If it weren't for you handling things, that stubborn girl and I might never have resolved our issues.
choice_prompt:4:1013827002.source_cn: 哼。要不是你把事情解决了，我和那个一根筋的家伙……未必能把话说开。
choice_prompt:4:1013827002.male: Hmm. If it weren't for you handling things, that stubborn girl and I might never have resolved our issues.
choice_prompt:4:1013827002.female: Hmm. If it weren't for you handling things, that stubborn girl and I might never have resolved our issues.

say:5:1013827003:1.text: I'm not sure. That's something I need to ask her.
say:5:1013827003:1.source_cn: 我可不知道。这件事得问她才行。
say:5:1013827003:1.male: I'm not sure. That's something I need to ask her.
say:5:1013827003:1.female: I'm not sure. That's something I need to ask her.

choice_prompt:6:1013827003.text: I'm not sure. That's something I need to ask her.
choice_prompt:6:1013827003.source_cn: 我可不知道。这件事得问她才行。
choice_prompt:6:1013827003.male: I'm not sure. That's something I need to ask her.
choice_prompt:6:1013827003.female: I'm not sure. That's something I need to ask her.

say:7:1013827004:1.text: Who knows? I've gotten too used to traveling around as a treasure hunter; I'm not even sure if I like it anymore...
say:7:1013827004:1.source_cn: 谁知道呢。我已经习惯了寻宝猎人独自漂泊的生活。好像太过...
say:7:1013827004:1.male: Who knows? I've gotten too used to traveling around as a treasure hunter; I'm not even sure if I like it anymore...
say:7:1013827004:1.female: Who knows? I've gotten too used to traveling around as a treasure hunter; I'm not even sure if I like it anymore...

choice:6:0:1.text: What are your plans for the future?
choice:6:0:1.male: What are your plans for the future?
choice:6:0:1.female: What are your plans for the future?

say:1:1013828001:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I intend to send Lucius back first to report the situation.
say:1:1013828001:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I intend to send Lucius back first to report the situation.
say:1:1013828001:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I intend to send Lucius back first to report the situation.

say:2:1013828002:1.text: The Temple needs immediate information in order to make timely decisions, I'm going to escort the acolytes.
say:2:1013828002:1.source_cn: 圣堂需要第一时间的情报，才能及时作出判断。我打算护送这...
say:2:1013828002:1.male: The Temple needs immediate information in order to make timely decisions, I'm going to escort the acolytes.
say:2:1013828002:1.female: The Temple needs immediate information in order to make timely decisions, I'm going to escort the acolytes.

say:3:1013828003:1.text: They'll rest a bit before we set off. They aren't skilled in combat, and the Hypofiends along the way may be dangerous.
say:3:1013828003:1.source_cn: 待他们稍加休整后再启程，他们不擅长武力，一路上的魔物将...
say:3:1013828003:1.male: They'll rest a bit before we set off. They aren't skilled in combat, and the Hypofiends along the way may be dangerous.
say:3:1013828003:1.female: They'll rest a bit before we set off. They aren't skilled in combat, and the Hypofiends along the way may be dangerous.

say:4:1013828004:0.text: Protecting those who need protection—rather than indulging in self-serving penance, that is what I should be doing.
say:4:1013828004:0.source_cn: 守护需要守护的人——比起自我满足的赎罪，这才是我应该做的事。
say:4:1013828004:0.male: Protecting those who need protection—rather than indulging in self-serving penance, that is what I should be doing.
say:4:1013828004:0.female: Protecting those who need protection—rather than indulging in self-serving penance, that is what I should be doing.

say:5:1013828005:0.text: If you ever need my strength to fight against Hypogeans in the future, I am at your disposal.
say:5:1013828005:0.source_cn: 如果您今后对抗恶魔时需要我的力量，特弥希娅随时供您召唤。
say:5:1013828005:0.male: If you ever need my strength to fight against Hypogeans in the future, I am at your disposal.
say:5:1013828005:0.female: If you ever need my strength to fight against Hypogeans in the future, I am at your disposal.

say:12:1013828009:2.text: Don't bother, the petty goddess won't bless me... I've said plenty of bad things about her.
say:12:1013828009:2.source_cn: 别，你们小心眼的女神是不会保佑我的。……我可没少说过她...

say:13:1013828010:1.text: Dura is compassionate. But that wasn't what I was going to say.
say:13:1013828010:1.source_cn: 艾雅是悲悯的。而且，我想说的不是这个。

say:14:1013828011:1.text: Ata... would you want to travel alongside me?
say:14:1013828011:1.source_cn: 阿塔……你是否愿意与我同行？

say:16:1013828012:1.text: It's been ages since we last met. I feel like... I've missed much of what's happened with you. I'd appreciate hearing about your experiences during these years—or anything, really...
say:16:1013828012:1.source_cn: 我们太久没见了。我觉得……我错过了许多你的事情。我想听...

say:17:1013828013:1.text: ... I get it. You're just looking for more help to protect these feeble acolytes on our journey, aren't you?
say:17:1013828013:1.source_cn: ……切。我看，你只是想要多个帮手，帮你一路保护这些手无...

say:18:1013828014:0.text: *Chuckle* If that's how you want to put it.

say:20:1013828015:2.text: Uh... Have you two patched things up? What happened? When did this happen?
say:20:1013828015:2.source_cn: 呃……两位这是又和好了？怎么回事？是什么时候发生的？

say:24:1013828017:2.text: You should go make your report to the general first! *Giggle* As for what happened, I'll tell you next time.
say:24:1013828017:2.source_cn: 你还是先去汇报吧。至于发生了什么，下次见面我可以偷偷告...

say:25:1013828018:2.text: Really! Oh, Hammie, thank you! I'm going to leave right away, there's no time to lose!
say:25:1013828018:2.source_cn: 真的吗！那漫漫小姐，多谢！事不宜迟，我出发了！

say:0:1013829001:0.text: I'll also take my leave. I need to discuss the current situation with an old friend.
say:0:1013829001:0.source_cn: 我也先走一步了。这里发生的事，我得去跟老朋友聊聊。
say:0:1013829001:0.male: I'll also take my leave. I need to discuss the current situation with an old friend.
say:0:1013829001:0.female: I'll also take my leave. I need to discuss the current situation with an old friend.

say:1:1013829002:0.text: Are you going to talk to Magistrate Hogan? Please stay safe on your journey.
say:1:1013829002:0.source_cn: 要去告知霍根治安官吗？请您一路小心。
say:1:1013829002:0.male: Are you going to talk to Magistrate Hogan? Please stay safe on your journey.
say:1:1013829002:0.female: Are you going to talk to Magistrate Hogan? Please stay safe on your journey.

say:2:1013829003:0.text: Hmm. About Dionel's warning... I should get ready to face some Hypogeans.
say:2:1013829003:0.source_cn: 嗯。关于萨基塔里斯的提醒……我想，我已经做好与恶魔战斗...
say:2:1013829003:0.male: Hmm. About Dionel's warning... I should get ready to face some Hypogeans.
say:2:1013829003:0.female: Hmm. About Dionel's warning... I should get ready to face some Hypogeans.

subtitle:1:1013805001:.text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the final act!

subtitle:1:1013805002:.text: How do you like my new little pet?
subtitle:1:1013805002:.source_cn: 喜欢我重新唤醒的小可爱吗？

subtitle:1:1013805004:.text: Don't worry. When he wakes, he'll tell you himself...
subtitle:1:1013805004:.source_cn: 别着急，它醒来了，自然会告诉你……

subtitle:1:1013810001:.text: The Faith Stone was in my heart all along?
subtitle:1:1013810001:.source_cn: 原来，圣石一直在我心里吗？

subtitle:1:1013817002:.source_cn: 竟然将我逼到如此境地。

subtitle:1:1013817003:.text: I'll show you what happens when you meddle with me.
subtitle:1:1013817003:.source_cn: 那就让你们看看触碰禁忌的下场……

subtitle:1:1013819001:.text: *Inhale* Hmm... fresh air, it's been a while.
subtitle:1:1013819001:.male: *Inhale* Hmm... fresh air, it's been a while.
subtitle:1:1013819001:.female: *Inhale* Hmm... fresh air, it's been a while.

subtitle:1:1013819003:.text: I almost forgot to introduce myself...
subtitle:1:1013819003:.male: I almost forgot to introduce myself...
subtitle:1:1013819003:.female: I almost forgot to introduce myself...

subtitle:1:1013819005:.text: Nice to meet you, Magister Merlin...
subtitle:1:1013819005:.male: Nice to meet you, Magister Merlin...
subtitle:1:1013819005:.female: Nice to meet you, Magister Merlin...

cinematic_dialogue:1:1013823001:.text: Ugh! I can't beat them, this really isn't fun...

cinematic_dialogue:1:1013823002:.text: This little clown is going to find something fun to play with elsewhere!

subtitle:2:1013803001:.text: The ground is shaking! Everyone, brace yourselves!
subtitle:2:1013803001:.source_cn: 是地面在震动！大家小心站稳！

say:5:1013802001:0.text: Everyone, please stop. There's a crucial ceremony ahead that cannot be disturbed.
say:5:1013802001:0.source_cn: 诸位，请止步。前方在举行重要的仪式，不能被打扰。

say:6:1013802002:0.text: It seems you're conducting a ritual involving sacred objects. Dura above... I am Templar Knight Temesia, here on orders—
say:6:1013802002:0.source_cn: 看来，你们在举行与圣物有关的仪式。艾雅在上，圣骑士特弥...

say:7:1013802003:0.text: Wait, what is this black rift in the ground?
say:7:1013802003:0.source_cn: 等等，地面上这道黑雾弥漫的裂隙是怎么回事？

say:9:1013802004:0.text: Is that glowing stone the sacred object we're meant to protect? What kind of ritual is this?
say:9:1013802004:0.source_cn: 中间这块发光的石头，就是咱们要保护的圣物吗？这到底是在...

say:10:1013802005:0.text: Temesia, have you ever seen a ritual like this before?
say:10:1013802005:0.source_cn: 特弥希娅， 你可曾见过这样的仪——

say:11:1013802006:0.text: That glowing stone... It's the Faith Stone...
say:11:1013802006:0.source_cn: 这块发光的石头……是圣石……

say:12:1013802007:0.text: But we found out the Faith Stone was taken by Atalanta, and then the Faith Stone was missing.
say:12:1013802007:0.source_cn: 可是，圣石不是被阿塔兰……总之，下落不明了吗？

say:13:1013802008:2.text: More importantly, Temesia... your chest is glowing!
say:13:1013802008:2.source_cn: 而且，特弥希娅……你的胸口在发光！你——

say:16:1013802009:0.text: Let's not dwell on that! Hey, you there! What's happening with this dark rift?
say:16:1013802009:0.source_cn: 先别管那个了！喂！修士，下面这道黑乎乎的裂隙到底是怎么回事？

say:17:1013802010:0.text: I don't see any reason to respond to someone rude like you.
say:17:1013802010:0.source_cn: 对无礼之徒的质问，我看不出有什么非要回答的理由。

say:18:1013802011:0.text: You'd better answer me, Acolyte! I won't hesitate to use my arrows to get you to talk!
say:18:1013802011:0.source_cn: 回答我，圣堂的家伙。我可不想浪费弩箭逼你开口！

say:19:1013802012:0.text: As I said, the Sun Temple is currently holding a crucial ceremony. Please, step aside—
say:19:1013802012:0.source_cn: 我已经说过了，日神殿现在是重要的仪式场所，请无关人等回避——

say:21:1013802013:3.text: Please, everyone, calm down. Since you requested aid, I presume you wouldn't object having more people come to help.
say:21:1013802013:3.source_cn: 他们无需回避。你们既然求援，想必需要一些协助。

say:22:1013802014:0.text: And as for these people... I vouch for them as a Templar Knight. They're trustworthy allies.
say:22:1013802014:0.source_cn: 而这些人……我以圣骑士的荣誉起誓，他们都是可以信任的重...

say:23:1013802015:0.text: Please, share the necessary information with us so we can assist in Dura's will.
say:23:1013802015:0.source_cn: 请把必要的情报分享给我们，以便我们双方更好地完成艾雅的...

say:27:1013802017:0.source_cn: 好了好了，让我来跟他们说吧。

say:30:1013802018:2.text: Templar Knight Temesia and Templar Knight Lucius, we do indeed need help.
say:30:1013802018:2.source_cn: 圣骑士特弥希娅和圣骑士卢修斯，我们现在的确需要一些帮助。

say:31:1013802019:0.text: The Sun Temple is where the goddess Dura sealed away Hypogeans in the past.
say:31:1013802019:0.source_cn: 此处日神殿——实则是当年女神艾雅镇压恶魔的所在。

choice_prompt:32:1013802019.text: The Sun Temple is where the goddess Dura sealed away Hypogeans in the past.
choice_prompt:32:1013802019.source_cn: 此处日神殿——实则是当年女神艾雅镇压恶魔的所在。

say:33:1013802020:2.text: During the Divine War, Dura sealed the Hypogeans in the abyss to protect the people of this land...
say:33:1013802020:2.source_cn: 第一次神魔大战之际，艾雅为了拯救这片大陆上的子民，将为...

say:34:1013802021:0.text: But as time passed, these dark rifts began showing up in various places. To prevent Hypogeans from breaking Dura's seal...
say:34:1013802021:0.source_cn: 但时间已经过去了太久，有些地方出现了这些暗之裂隙，为避...

say:35:1013802022:0.text: We carry the Faith Stone to try and mend the rift. However, the rift is too powerful; we can only temporarily stall its growth.
say:35:1013802022:0.source_cn: 我们携带了圣石，试图弥合裂隙。但裂隙太过于强大，我们只...

say:36:1013802023:0.text: To stop the rift from expanding and to protect the Faith Stone from anyone who may come to seek it, we requested the assistance of the Templar Knights.
say:36:1013802023:0.source_cn: 为了避免裂隙进一步扩大，以及处理圣石引起的骚动和觊觎，...

say:37:1013802024:2.source_cn: 原来如此，我们自当坚守职责。

say:40:1013802025:2.text: So, the black rift on the ground harbors a Hypogean? Hammie, if you're scared, hold Chippy's hand!
say:40:1013802025:2.source_cn: 原来地上黑漆漆的裂隙里有恶魔吗？漫漫，害怕的话，拉住我的手！

say:42:1013802026:2.text: I-I'm not scared! And your hand's shaking too...
say:42:1013802026:2.source_cn: 我我我才不怕！而且满满你的手，也在抖……

say:43:1013802027:1.text: Chippy's not shaking!... Huh? What's happening?
say:43:1013802027:1.source_cn: 我没有抖啊？……咦？怎么回事？

subtitle:46:1013803001:.text: The ground is shaking! Everyone, brace yourselves!
subtitle:46:1013803001:.source_cn: 是地面在震动！大家小心站稳！

narration:48:10138122:0.text: The ground suddenly starts violently shaking, and the Sun Temple experiences a severe tremor.
narration:48:10138122:0.source_cn: 突然之间，地动山摇，日神殿发生了猛烈的震动！

narration:49:10138121:0.text: In the depths of the Sun Temple, the acolytes use the Faith Stone to suppress the rift. Meanwhile, a similar light emanates from Temesia's chest.
narration:49:10138121:0.source_cn: 日神殿深处，圣堂修士正在用圣石压制黑雾弥漫的裂隙。与此...

subtitle:1:1013819005:.text: It's a pleasure to meet you, Lord Merlin...
